layer_B_historical_268m.method: Univariate GARCH(1,1) Gaussian on STR_1715 monthly net returns, expanding window 60m burn-in, refit every 12m

vol_target_decision.rationale: Statistical: median of expanding 36m realized vol provides natural target reflecting strategy's own volatility regime. Capped at 15% (heuristic ceiling for conservative defense alignment with mdd_target ≤ -25%). NO fixed % heuristic chosen unilaterally.
